entries.narration: Human actions add 9 gigatons of carbon to our atmosphere every single year.

sources.excerpt: A public-domain illustrated diagram of the carbon cycle across atmosphere, land and ocean. Arrows are labelled with fluxes in GtC/y (gigatons of carbon per year); numbers in parentheses are stored carbon pools; red indicates carbon from human emissions. Pools: Atmosphere (800), Plant biomass (550), Soil (2300), Fossil pool (10,000), Surface ocean (1000), Deep ocean (37,000), Reactive sediments (60
